text:
alex kim: Quick question — for the rerank endpoint, do we want to include the full per-candidate raw_scores in the default response? Or make it opt-in via ?debug=true? Also what's the TTL we should set for candidate list cache (KV cache) — 60s or 300s?

maria gonzalez: i'd opt opt-in for raw_scores, 99% of customers don't need them. exposing by default increases payload size + egress costs. :+1:

chris taylor: agree on opt-in. + also need to think about sampling for telemetry — we can't store full blobs for everything. propose sample=0.01 for full-score retention :thinking_face:

nina patel: per-tenant sampling would be better. low-volume tenants we sample 100% for debugging, high-volume 1%.

pj: console question — can we surface sampled requests in the Logs view with a link to the full score blob? where do we store blobs? s3 encrypted? need perms

alex kim: storing in s3 (encrypted via KMS) is fine. link pattern: https://console.redwood/tenant/{tid}/rerank/sample/{blob_id}

maria gonzalez: TL;DR: default response shape should include topK and normalized confidence only. debug=true returns full_scores, provenance, model_affinity. example payload:
```
{"topk":[{"id":"c1","score":0.92},{"id":"c2","score":0.87}],"debug_token":"blob_abc123","ttl_s":60}
```

chris taylor: on TTL — 60s seems reasonable for interactive ranking. 300s could improve cache hit but stale if user navigates. maybe make TTL configurable per route

nina patel: +1 on route-level TTL. default 60s, override via deployment config.

pj: dashboard: we should show sampling rate, bytes saved (approx), and hits vs misses for cache. also a button to "fetch sample" that paginates

alex kim: question about billing: if we return debug=true with full_scores, do we bill tokens/scores differently? we need to align with quota calculation

chris taylor: bill based on fanout + scoring ops. debug payloads counted as full cost; sampled storage billed separately to infra

nina patel: let's add a console toggle per-tenant to force 100% sampling (support/debug mode)

pj: UX note: in rollout, show warn banner when enabling debug — could spike egress/costs. include estimated cost delta

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: rerank-service v2.14 -> canary on infra-group alpha (10%) — 1733333380

alex kim: ok next steps: write API change, config knobs: `debug_response: boolean`, `telemetry_sample: float`, `candidate_ttl_s: int` — I'll draft a PR and add console hooks. tagging @maria gonzalez @chris taylor for API contract.

maria gonzalez: thanks — ping me on the PR for contract review. :eyes:

chris taylor: i'll add billing tests and quota sim. also add unit test to ensure debug=false strips raw_scores

nina patel: i'll update deployment docs + default configs in infra repo

pj: i'll mock the console card and cost estimate microcopy

alex kim: great! landing timeline? aim for next weekly release if no blockers

maria gonzalez: sounds good

pj: filed followups: https://git.redwood/issue/4567 and dashboard mock: https://figma.redwood/d/89abc
